gigs.title: Architect Autonomous Multi-Modal RAG Platform with Next.js 15 & Supabase Vector
gigs.description:
We are seeking a seasoned Principal Full-Stack & AI Engineer to design and deploy an end-to-end Enterprise RAG platform.

Key Deliverables:
1. Supabase pgvector embedding pipelines with hybrid sparse/dense search.
2. Next.js 15 App Router interface with streaming token response & optimistic state caching.
3. Row Level Security (RLS) policies ensuring strict enterprise data tenant isolation.
4. Comprehensive Jest integration tests and GitHub Actions CI/CD deployment.
